lines: > **pre-flight #265:** ⛔ NOT CAPTURED — UNMEASURED. Reason unchanged from #199…#264: this is a DELEGATED wrap sub, and the pre-flight estimate is a CONDUCTOR-seat act made before the brief is cut. ⚠ **A guessed pre-flight would be a fabricated datapoint in the very dataset the 15% reserve waits to be re-derived from** [[feedback-measuring-tool-must-not-guess]]. ✅ **THE OTHER TWO TERMS ARE MEASURED FOR A SECOND CONSECUTIVE SESSION: the conductor's FILL at the brief cut was MEASURED and DECLARED (147,425 real) and BOOT was MEASURED at his opener (70,260 real)** — `tiktoken` was installed at the opener rather than after the fact. Steps 1 · 1b · 2 · 2c · 2d · 2e · 2f · 2g · 4 · 4b · 4c · 4d · 5, in order, per `knowledge/_RUNBOOK-capture-ritual.md`. **Step 3 (memory) is a SEAT LIMIT, DECLARED NOT SKIPPED** — the store's path lies outside both directories this seat's file tools accept and is invisible to the shell; ✅ **the brief declared it off-limits in front and the conductor wrote the hook himself before delegating**, for the second wrap running.

> **POST-MORTEM #265 — measured, not narrated.** ⚙ **TWO OBJECTS, REPORTED SEPARATELY, NEVER SUMMED OR CONVERTED** [[measure-dont-convert-units]]: **FILL** is resident context (`message.usage`); **THROUGHPUT** is the cumulative log (`_checkin.py`'s headline). **FILL: 147,425 real DECLARED by the conductor at the brief cut · 148,308 real measured first-hand at this seat (47 turns)** — two readings of a moving number, minutes apart; both stand, neither is the other. ✅ **147,425 is 32,575 UNDER the `s260-D2` delegated stop line of 180,000 and 52,575 under the 200,000 working ceiling** ⇒ ⛔ **THIS WRAP IS DELEGATED FOR A REASON THE STOP LINE DOES NOT DESCRIBE: Dave went to bed** (*"lets crack on we have lots of tokens to use, we have spare budget and Im going to bed soon"*) **and the conductor's seat is held open for his read-back.** That is a NEW cause for a delegation in this dataset and is written as one rather than filed under the stop line. **THROUGHPUT 142,627 cl100k-estimate at this seat.** ⛔ **BOOT 70,260 real, MEASURED at the conductor's opener — 260 OVER the 70,000 shrink-only literal.** It ends **eight consecutive under-ceiling readings** (#264 read 69,955, 45 under) and is **RECORDED AS A BREACH**: `s240-D2`/`s241-D1` make the number shrink-only, the remedy is to cut the boot, raising the literal is Dave's word alone, and it is **not a price a wrap may pay to unblock itself** [[gate-must-quote-what-it-forbids]]. The boot-drift arm's own standing refusal is still **#255's 70,127** and is not cleared here.

> **wrap-handover: brief-cut 147,425 real (conductor, DECLARED in the wrap brief) · sub-cut 148,308 real (first-hand `knowledge/_checkin.py` at this seat, 47 turns, boot 70,260) · delta 883 real · replay unobservable (conductor-side, post-wrap)**

> **⚠ THE `subs` LINE ABOVE IS MEASURED, AND WHAT IT DOES NOT CONTAIN IS DECLARED.** Its six terms are Agent `usage` readings, REAL Claude tokens and **QUOTA, never window FILL** — the two `/goal` drivers **48,453** + **49,700**, lane **B 117,210**, lane **C 148,627**, lane **D 80,597**, lane **E 115,314**. ⛔ **THIS WRAP SEAT'S OWN SPEND IS NOT IN THE FIGURE AND NO NUMBER IS WRITTEN FOR IT** — a sub cannot read its own `message.usage` from inside itself, and an UNKNOWN is never turned into a number [[feedback-measuring-tool-must-not-guess]]. The figure is never added to this block's fill numbers and never graded against the stop line.

> **COMMIT STATE #265:** ⬛ **THE HASH IS A DECLARED GAP IN THIS BLOCK, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE — A COMMIT CANNOT NAME ITSELF.** The wrap commit's sha is in the chat wrap message and in `git log`. ✅ **NO DATE SPLIT — session, ritual and commit are all 2026-09-09, and nothing was re-dated because nothing needed to be.** ⛔ **THE SESSION'S SIX COMMITS `9a24af9..087e058` ARE LOCAL AND UNPUSHED, AND THIS WRAP'S COMMIT IS THE SEVENTH — NOTHING IS PUSHED HERE.** `s133-D2` makes the push **Dave's word** and he is asleep; the brief says so in terms. ⚠ **GENERATOR OUTPUTS RIDE WITH THIS COMMIT AS GATE-RUN SIDE EFFECTS, NOT AS EDITS** — `notes/_RULINGS.html` (ritual step 4d, re-rendered because the rehearsal found it STALE at `c17b45e3…` against the store's `e2bd1b3f…`), `knowledge/_memento-index.json` (step 2g), `knowledge/_INTEGRITY-REPORT.md` (regenerated by lane E's gate run — **#265's own enactment debris**, not a wrap edit), `notes/_REHEARSAL-LOG.jsonl`, `notes/_dream/_GRADE-DECISIONS.jsonl`; nothing in them was hand-written. ⛔ **AND THE REDS THEY REPORT ARE THE ONES THIS SESSION DID NOT CLOSE, NAMED SO THE NEXT SEAT DOES NOT READ THEM AS ITS OWN DAMAGE** — `_build_integrity.py`'s 14 (a schema-decision family, lane C's RSQs 1–5) and `_validate_kg.py`'s 5 (four unseated edge types plus the generator freshness arm, lane E's RSQs 1–2). ⛔ **THE `.git` LOCK STORY IS CORRECTED IN THIS BLOCK RATHER THAN LEFT STANDING:** the "stale `index.lock`" carried since #261 was the **Cowork sandbox refusing every unlink** until `allow_cowork_file_delete` was granted mid-session — git's own lockfiles and `tmp_obj_*` objects survived each commit because nothing could remove them. Granted, cleared, and the cause is a PERMISSION, not a dead process.
